title: CORE-7007 · SITEWIDE: FAQ/service CTA band heading is <h2> on clone (live is <h3>)
body:
**Linear:** [CORE-7007](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-7007/rf-sitewide-faq-cta-band-heading-is-an-h2-on-clone-live-is-h3)

## Verified 2026-08-24 — reproduces

The "Register your company today" closing CTA band renders `<h2>` on the clone where live
renders `<h3>`. Rendered type is identical on both (32px, weight 700) — only the element
tag differs. Same defect class as CORE-7018 (FAQ accordion `<h3>` → `<h4>`, shipped as a
one-line change in PR #89).

| Page | Clone | Live |
|---|---|---|
| `/faqs/vat/` | `<h2>` | `<h3>` |
| `/vat-registration/` | `<h2>` | `<h3>` |

**SITEWIDE claim verified, not assumed:** live uses `<h3>` on both a FAQ page and a service
page, and the clone uses `<h2>` on both — so a single shared-component change is correct here.
This is NOT the CORE-7119/7120 situation where live deliberately differs by context and a
blanket rule would regress a sibling.

## Location

`src/components/shared/ClosingCTA/index.tsx` — `<Text as="h2" …>` → `as="h3"`.

Confirmed this component and not the similar `RegisterCtaPanel` by matching the rendered DOM
class against the styles files: the band carries
`mb-2 block text-[32px] font-bold leading-[1.235] text-[var(--surface-brand-cyan)]`, which is
`ClosingCTA.styles.ts` verbatim. `RegisterCtaPanel` is 36px / weight 400 and is a different band.
acceptanceCriteria: The closing CTA band heading ("Register your company today") renders `<h3>` on the clone, matching live.
Rendered type is unchanged — 32px, weight 700, same colour, same position and spacing.
Verified on both a FAQ page (`/faqs/vat/`) and a service page (`/vat-registration/`), since the component is shared.
No other heading level on those pages changes — `<h1>` page title and the "How we are rated" `<h2>` stay as they are.
